story.title: The Taiwan years
story.content: In November 1946, Zhang Xueliang and Zhao Yidi were flown to Taiwan and held at Qingquan (清泉), a hot-spring area in the mountains of Wufeng, Hsinchu. He was moved several times over the following years, and from August 1961 he lived in a house in Beitou, Taipei, built on land he bought; it became his longest home in Taiwan. Restrictions eased after 1988, and on 1 June 1990 friends hosted a public 90th-birthday celebration for him at Taipei's Grand Hotel (圆山饭店), widely seen as marking his freedom. These are the Taiwan years behind speech line 7.

keySentence.chinese: 一九四六年，张学良和赵一荻到了台湾。
keySentence.pinyin: Yī jiǔ sì liù nián, Zhāng Xuéliáng hé Zhào Yīdí dào le Táiwān.
keySentence.english: In 1946, Zhang Xueliang and Zhao Yidi arrived in Taiwan.

vocabulary.example: 我去看望祖父。Wǒ qù kànwàng zǔfù.
他讲了一个故事。Tā jiǎng le yí ge gùshi.
我感受到了他的爱。Wǒ gǎnshòu dào le tā de ài.
他深爱他的家人。Tā shēn'ài tā de jiārén.
中国人民很热情。Zhōngguó rénmín hěn rèqíng.

practiceLines.chinese: 我从一岁起，每年都去台湾看望祖父。
practiceLines.pinyin: Wǒ cóng yí suì qǐ, měinián dōu qù Táiwān kànwàng zǔfù.
practiceLines.english: From the age of one, I visited my grandfather in Taiwan every year.

practiceLines.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ jiǎng le hěn duō gùshi.

practiceLines.chinese: 从这些故事里，我感受到他深爱中国，深爱中国人民。
practiceLines.pinyin: Cóng zhèxiē gùshi lǐ, wǒ gǎnshòu dào tā shēn ài Zhōngguó, shēn ài Zhōngguó rénmín.
practiceLines.english: Through those stories, I felt how deeply he loved China and the Chinese people.

pronunciationTip:
一岁 is yí suì [dict. yī suì], because 岁 is a 4th tone; same with 一个 yí ge (个 is 4th tone in the dictionary). Line 8 has three 3rd tones in a row, 给我讲 gěi wǒ jiǎng: say it "géi wó jiǎng", only the last one dips. 很多 hěn duō: just a low 很, no rise. Line 9: pause once at the first comma, and keep the two 深爱 phrases even, like a rhythm: 深爱中国 / 深爱中国人民.
**Daily run-through:** read all 14 lines of the main speech aloud once (about 90 sec), then listen to full_speech_normal.mp3 once.
